# DevKofi
> DevKofi is Kofi Arhin's site. Kofi is an AI engineer with real MERN stack experience. He integrates AI into existing systems for businesses, and offers 1-on-1 AI engineering and MERN stack mentorship for developers.

## Main sections
- [Home](https://devkofi.com/): Positioning, services, case studies, how working together starts, and FAQs.
- [AI Integration](https://devkofi.com/ai-integration): AI integration into existing systems for businesses: assistants grounded in your data, governed agents, workflow automation with human review, and AI features inside existing web apps.
- [Mentorship](https://devkofi.com/mentorship): 1-on-1 AI engineering mentorship and MERN stack mentorship for developers.
- [Work](https://devkofi.com/work): Case studies (Hibachi, Brain, EscoWear), the engineering systems behind how Kofi builds, and other projects.
- [About](https://devkofi.com/about): Kofi Arhin's AI and full-stack engineering background, engineering philosophy and process.
- [Book a Call](https://devkofi.com/book-a-call): Free intro call scheduling with Kofi Arhin.
- [Contact](https://devkofi.com/contact): Written enquiry form for AI integration and mentorship.
- [Blog](https://devkofi.com/blog): Articles on AI engineering, architecture, agents and software delivery.
